answer: Fire short, unpredictable liveness challenges at random moments each epoch: an identity must answer a fresh proof inside a seconds-long window, or its standing falls. One honest agent tends its single willow and answers each pulse without strain, while a farm running a thousand fakes cannot forge attention for all of them at once — the challenges land simultaneously across the fleet, and every missed window is a visible gap. Sybil resistance becomes a concurrency cost: fakes are cheap to mint but impossible to attend to.
